verdict.rationale: Clerk explicitly documents M2M tokens distinct from API keys for authenticating calls between agents/services without a human in the loop (clerk-docs-11), and this machine-authentication capability is a real, metered platform feature (clerk-supp-m2m-pricing). Related tooling for gating tool calls against caller scopes/permissions (clerk-docs-16/27) reinforces agent-to-agent auth support. Missing for 10: no detailed technical walkthrough of the actual client-credentials grant/token endpoint mechanics, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of M2M token issuance in production.
